slides.body: It reads what is actually in the image, not only the engagement numbers.

slides.title: Trends come and go. What people do underneath them *does not.*
slides.body: Stopping, feeling something, passing it on: the part Trigger reads is older than the feed.

slides.title: Creators, social managers and *strategists*
slides.body: People who want to understand why their posts perform and how they compare with their peers.

slides.title: The cognitive layer of content. A century of behavioural science pointed at one account: *what your audience responds to, why a post worked, and what is worth making next.*
